call_DatabricksEmbeddingHandler_embeddin: call the DatabricksEmbeddingHandler.embedding method to generate embeddings for a list of input texts
validate_Databricks_environment: validate the Databricks environment for embeddings endpoint with api_base and api_key
extract_custom_user_agent: extract custom user agent from optional_params or environment variables for Databricks API telemetry
use_OpenAILikeEmbedding_handler: use the OpenAILikeEmbeddingHandler base class to make embedding API calls via super()
pass_Databricks_embedding_params: pass model, input, timeout, and optional_params to the Databricks embedding handler
